title: Feature: Handle TiC Tool Repair Requests
body:
Fixes #6: Hook into MineColonies' request system for broken Tinkers' Construct tools.
This patch integrates TiC tool durability with MineColonies request systems:
- Overrides `damageInventoryItem` so TiC tools are not destroyed upon reaching 0 durability.
- Attaches the appropriate repair material tag (resolved via `TiCMaterialResolver`) to the broken tool.
- If a Blacksmith building is available, generates a two-part request system for a Courier to transport the broken tool to the Blacksmith and fetch the required repair material from the Warehouse.
- Implements a fallback: if no Blacksmith is present, deposits the broken tool directly into the worker's hut block inventory, allowing the player to manually retrieve and repair it.
